department: Department of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants should apply by January 7, 2027. The department admissions page gives January 20 for international students seeking departmental aid.

also.quote: Domestic students seeking departmental financial support, and all international students: Fall semester – January 20

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is required, with a waiver option; the department says it is required for international applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test required with the option to waive

also.quote: GRE is required for PhD applicants, unless you have already have an earned doctoral degree

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; students get a research advisor by the end of the first year.
supervisor.quote: By the end of the first year, students should have a faculty member to serve as the research advisor

entry_route.value: Bachelor's applicants may apply, but a master's in computer science is strongly recommended for PhD applicants.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. applicants strongly recommended to have M.S. degree in computer science

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the department pages checked.

funding.value: Not stated on the department pages checked.

notes: Software Engineering and Human-Centered Computing PhDs are listed by the Information Systems department and were not researched separately. The department page does not state funding terms; the Information Systems PhD lists AI/ML and Data Science as research areas, not a separate program.
